errors.adminTemplateDelete: The Assistant's template cannot be deleted.
errors.providerOff: This AI provider is not available.

templates.title: Agent templates
templates.description: House templates: the GUIDU Assistant template of every partner and the GUIDS any customer can start from.

form.name: Template name
form.createHint: Start with the name. The configuration of the five tabs comes next, in the same panel.
form.published: Published (customers see it when creating a GUIDS)
form.publishedAdmin: The Assistant's template is always published
form.invalidStored: The stored configuration of this template is not valid. Review the tabs and save again.
form.deleteMessage: Delete the template {name}? GUIDS created from it keep the configuration they already have.

backup.title: Backup key
backup.description: Platform key and cheap model used only to finish, for up to 24 hours, the open conversations of a GUIDS whose customer key failed. It does not count toward the customer's usage.
backup.off: Without a key and model the backup is off: a GUIDS stops answering as soon as the customer's key fails.

form.keyHint: Leave blank to keep the saved key. The key is encrypted and shown masked only.
form.clearKey: Remove the key (turns the backup off)

hints.variables: Agent constants, used in the prompt as '{{'agent.var.key'}}'.

handoff_mode.high_intent: Hand off when the lead shows high intent
handoff_mode.always_ask: Always ask whether the lead wants to talk to a person

after_hours_behavior.offer_callback: Offer a callback during service hours

out_of_scope_action.escalate_team: Forward to the team (or to a referral)
out_of_scope_action.say_dont_know: Say it does not know and move on

create_contact.label: Create contact
create_contact.desc: Creates the contact in the workspace CRM.

add_note.label: Add note
add_note.desc: Records a note on the contact.

update_contact_property.label: Update contact field
update_contact_property.desc: Writes the contact fields open to the AI.

set_conversation_variable.label: Conversation memory
set_conversation_variable.desc: Keeps a value for the rest of the conversation.

add_tag.label: Add tag
add_tag.desc: Depends on tags in the CRM.

think.label: Think
think.desc: Organizes its reasoning before answering, with no effect.

score_lead.label: Score lead
score_lead.desc: Applies the scoring rules of the Rules tab.

handoff.label: Hand off to a person
handoff.desc: Passes the conversation to the team.

send_portfolio_media.label: Send from the Portfolio
send_portfolio_media.desc: Sends images and documents of the Portfolio's items.

workspace_read.label: Read the workspace
workspace_read.desc: Reads dashboard data with the permissions of who asks.

propose_operation.label: Propose an action
propose_operation.desc: Suggests an action the person confirms.

refer_contact.label: Refer a partner
refer_contact.desc: Refers the contact to one of the registered referrals and tells the person in charge.

text.title: Text
text.note: Talks with the contact and reads images and documents.

voice.title: Voice
voice.note: Hears the contact's audio and answers in audio when the contact sent audio.

embeddings.title: Embeddings
embeddings.note: Used by the agent's knowledge bases.

model.noVoice: The text key has no voice. Choose an OpenAI or Gemini key for the agent to hear and answer audio; without it, the agent asks the contact to write.
model.voiceKeyNoVoice: This key has no voice. Choose an OpenAI or Gemini key.
model.outsideWarning: This model is not in the catalog. The agent keeps answering; choose a model from the list when you can.
model.providerOffWarning: The provider of this key was turned off. The agent keeps answering; switch to a key of an allowed provider when you can.

assistant.title: GUIDU Assistant
assistant.description: The dashboard assistant: answers your team in /admin and your customers in /app, with your brand. It uses an admin AI key.
assistant.missing: Fill in to turn it on: {fields}.
assistant.noKeys: Add a key in AI keys to choose the Assistant's model.
assistant.readOnly: Only the partner's owners and admins change the Assistant.
assistant.invalidStored: The stored configuration of the Assistant is not valid. Review it and save again.

keys.title: AI keys
keys.description: Admin keys, used by the GUIDU Assistant in /admin and for your customers' questions in /app. Your customers' GUIDS use each customer's own key.
keys.revokeMessage: Revoke the key {label}? The Assistant stops using it at once.

form.label: Name
form.hint: The key is encrypted and shown masked only.

partnerTemplates.title: Agent templates
partnerTemplates.description: The partner's GUIDS templates. Once published, your customers see them next to the house's templates.
partnerTemplates.published: Published (your customers see it when creating a GUIDS)

guids.title: Customer GUIDS
guids.description: Your customers' agents. You change their configuration and referrals; the customer sees the change was yours. Conversations, leads and the knowledge base still need the support grant.
guids.missing: Fill in to turn it on: {fields}.
guids.readOnly: Only the partner's owners and admins change the GUIDS.
guids.invalidStored: The stored configuration of this GUIDS is not valid. Review it and save again.
guids.keyHint: The AI key is the customer's and stays in their vault: they choose it in /app.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.hint: Who the agent forwards out-of-scope leads to. They apply to every GUIDS of this customer.
referrals.name: Name
referrals.tagHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, - or _. Unique for this customer.
referrals.deleteMessage: The referral {name} stops receiving this customer's leads.

noticeWebhook.title: Hot lead notices (webhook)
noticeWebhook.description: When a GUIDS of your customers finds a hot lead, GUIDU posts the notice to this address, signed with the secret. Your flow (n8n, Evolution) sends the message from the merchant's Assistant number to the person set in the GUIDS.
noticeWebhook.secretHint: At least 16 characters. The notice carries the X-Guidu-Signature header (HMAC SHA-256 of timestamp.body).
noticeWebhook.secretKeep: Leave blank to keep the current secret.
noticeWebhook.removeMessage: Lead notices stop going out until you add another one.

dashboard.title: AI
dashboard.description: Usage and errors of the AI providers across every partner, from the consumption recorded on each model call.
dashboard.partnerDescription: AI usage and errors of your customers and of your Assistant, from the consumption recorded on each model call.

notices.backup_missing: The backup key is not set: a GUIDS stops answering as soon as the customer's key fails.
notices.agents_backup: {count, plural, one {# GUIDS answering} other {# GUIDS answering}} with the backup key because the customer's key failed.
notices.agents_failed: {count, plural, one {# GUIDS paused} other {# GUIDS paused}} because the key failed for more than 24 hours.
notices.provider_errors: {provider} with {count, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}} in the period.
notices.provider_off: Agents on a provider turned off, still answering: {count}.
notices.model_off: Agents on a model outside the catalog, still answering: {count}.
notices.agents_no_model: {count, plural, one {# active GUIDS} other {# active GUIDS}} without a key or model.
notices.assistant_no_key: Active Assistant without an AI key.

providersPage.title: Providers and models
providersPage.description: Which AI providers partners and customers may choose and the models allowed in each one. The first model of each list is the default.
providersPage.partnerDescription: Narrow the providers and models your customers may choose, within what the platform allows. The first model of each list is the default.
providersPage.providersHint: Turning a provider off does not stop the agents that already use it: they keep answering and show up in the dashboard notices.
providersPage.modelsHint: One model per line, as the provider writes it (e.g. gpt-5-mini). An empty list leaves the model free for the provider.
providersPage.partnerModelsHint: Check the models your customers may choose.
providersPage.freeModel: The platform left the model free for this provider. List your customers' models here, one per line, or leave it empty.
providersPage.syncNote: Models are edited by hand: keys belong to each owner and there is no global key to query the providers.
providersPage.baseUrlHint: Optional. An https address of a gateway compatible with the provider's API (for instance your own gateway). Conversations and the key test go through it, with the address checked on every connection; transcription and voice go straight to the provider.
providersPage.readOnly: Read only: owner and admin change it.

errors.noProvider: Turn on at least one provider.
errors.notOffered: Choose only what the platform allows.
errors.noModel: Leave at least one model in each provider.
errors.baseUrl: Use an https:// address without user or parameters.
